name: supermarket-billing-software
description: Full-stack supermarket billing, POS, inventory, and Electron desktop application.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix electron
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix electron"
scripts.dist:win: npm run build --prefix client && npm run dist:win --prefix electron
